wudu.title: Intention (Niyyah)
wudu.description: Form the intention in your heart to perform wudu for the sake of Allah, purifying yourself before worship. The intention is not spoken aloud.

wudu.title: Say Bismillah
wudu.description: Begin by saying "In the name of Allah," as taught in the Sunnah before starting wudu.

wudu.title: Wash the Hands
wudu.description: Wash both hands up to the wrists three times, making sure water reaches between the fingers.

wudu.title: Rinse the Mouth
wudu.description: Take water into the mouth and rinse it thoroughly, three times.

wudu.title: Rinse the Nose
wudu.description: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and then blow it out, three times.

wudu.title: Wash the Face
wudu.description: Wash the whole face three times, from the hairline to the chin and from ear to ear.

wudu.title: Wash the Right Arm
wudu.description: Wash the right arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

wudu.title: Wash the Left Arm
wudu.description: Wash the left arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

wudu.title: Wipe the Head
wudu.description: With wet hands, wipe over the head once, moving from the front to the back and then back to the front.

wudu.title: Wipe the Ears
wudu.description: Wipe the inside of the ears with the index fingers and the outside with the thumbs, once.

wudu.title: Wash the Right Foot
wudu.description: Wash the right foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

wudu.title: Wash the Left Foot
wudu.description: Wash the left foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

wudu.title: Recite After Wudu
wudu.description: After completing wudu, it is Sunnah to bear witness to the oneness of Allah and ask to be among those who purify themselves.

salahVariants.label: Salah Essentials
salahVariants.description: The core sequence of a single unit (rakah) of prayer, from the opening takbir through the final tashahhud.

steps.title: Intention (Niyyah)
steps.description: Face the Qibla and form the intention in your heart for the specific prayer you are about to perform.

steps.title: Opening Takbir (Takbiratul Ihram)
steps.description: Raise your hands and say the opening takbir, which begins the prayer.

steps.title: Opening Supplication (Istiftah)
steps.description: Standing (Qiyam), recite the opening supplication silently before beginning recitation.

steps.title: Recite Al-Fatihah
steps.description: Recite Surah Al-Fatihah, which is required in every unit of prayer, followed (in most units) by another passage from the Qur'an.

steps.title: Bowing (Ruku)
steps.description: Bow with your back straight and hands resting on your knees, saying the glorification of your Lord three times.

steps.title: Rising from Ruku
steps.description: Stand up straight from the bow, saying the praise of Allah.

steps.title: Prostration (Sujood)
steps.description: Prostrate with your forehead, nose, palms, knees, and toes touching the ground, saying the glorification of your Lord, the Most High, three times.

steps.title: Sitting Between the Two Prostrations
steps.description: Sit up briefly between the two prostrations, asking for forgiveness, before prostrating a second time.

steps.title: Tashahhud
steps.description: Sitting after two units (and again at the end of the prayer), recite the tashahhud, testifying to the oneness of Allah and the Prophethood of Muhammad ﷺ.

steps.title: Salawat Upon the Prophet
steps.description: In the final tashahhud, send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, as taught in the Sunnah.

steps.title: Ending the Prayer (Taslim)
steps.description: Turn your head to the right, then to the left, saying the closing greeting to end the prayer.

arabicSource.translation: Peace and the mercy of Allah be upon you
